## Technical Details
This website is built using React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, GSAP for smooth animations, and Lenis for smooth scrolling. It is fully optimized for Core Web Vitals, Accessibility (WCAG), and modern SEO standards (JSON-LD schemas, Open Graph).
